value.account:
Cause: at target >=2.29 the lowering emits repeat_until.on_exhausted output result__report = {ref: <exhausted_placeholders step>} for a path field of a non-exhausted variant. validation._validate_repeat_until_on_exhausted rejected every relpath output before checking whether the override was the compiler-generated ref. Fixing only that made it compile but exhaustion then failed at runtime: the match join reads loop outputs by address and never followed the persisted {ref} override (result__report placeholder and result__rounds own-state ref), so output validation saw a dict.
Changes: (1) orchestrator/workflow/validation.py: moved the exact generated-ref check (only active when the compiler-owned flag is set and the ref equals the captured one) ahead of the relpath rejection; authored refs/literals on relpath outputs are still rejected (existing test_loader_validation test still passes). (2) orchestrator/workflow/executor.py _resolve_bound_address: for LoopOutputAddress, a stored artifact of the form {ref: str} is resolved via _resolve_ref_value; unresolved raises ReferenceResolutionError. (3) tests/test_workflow_lisp_loop_result_paths.py: compile at 2.28-2.32, runtime outputs equal between 2.28 and 2.32 for exhaustion and approval, malformed reviewer output (APPROVE without report) still fails the run.
Discarded: resolving override refs when building the exhaustion frame artifacts in loops.py; it fixed the case but changed persisted artifacts and broke an existing test (test_loop_recur_on_exhausted_scalar_frame_carriage...) that pins the raw ref, so I reverted it for the read-side fix. Considered making the lowering omit the placeholder at relpath outputs, which would match 2.28 literally, but the placeholder is what feeds the 2.29 rich-value normalization.
Not covered: did not run the full suite (only loop/validation/executor-related modules: loader_validation, exhaustion_state, rich_loop_values_e2e, loop_recur, characterization, session_artifact, scoped_union_guards, human_input, strict_boolean, human_reply_checkpoints, all passing); resume after an exhausted loop with placeholder refs not specifically tested; the read-side ref following applies to any 2.x loop output ref, not only path fields. No commit made; bugs/ untouched.
value.summary: Generated exhaustion placeholder refs for relpath outputs are now accepted by validation and followed at runtime, so the loop result program behaves at 2.29-2.32 as at 2.28.

value.account: Two defects. (1) orchestrator/workflow/validation.py _validate_repeat_until_on_exhausted: the 'may only override scalar repeat_until outputs' relpath rejection ran before the check for the compiler-emitted generated on_exhausted ref. From 2.29 the lowerer emits a ref to an '__exhausted_placeholders' step for inactive-variant path fields, which tripped the rejection. I moved the generated-ref check first; it is only honoured when allow_generated_repeat_until_on_exhausted_refs is set and the ref exactly equals the compiler-captured one for that step/output, so authored relpath overrides (including authored refs) are still rejected. (2) After that, exhaustion failed at runtime: orchestrator/workflow/executor.py _resolve_bound_address returned the stored on_exhausted override dict {'ref': ...} verbatim for LoopOutputAddress reads (2.29+ match joins use bound addresses; the 2.28 path chases refs through _resolve_ref_value), so return__rounds failed integer validation. LoopOutputAddress reads now chase an exact {'ref': str} value via _resolve_ref_value; the value is still validated by the consumer contract, so malformed output still fails (my test confirms a missing report file fails the run). Tests: tests/test_workflow_lisp_loop_result_path_variants.py runs a union-with-path loop end to end at 2.28/2.29/2.32 for exhaustion, approval, and missing-report failure. Targeted modules run (new test, rich_loop_values_e2e, loop_recur, generic_state_exhaustion, loader_validation, imported_stdlib_loop_exhaustion_post_loop_terminal, executor_characterization): 341 passed, 1 xfailed. Considered and discarded: not emitting placeholder refs at 2.29+ (would break the rich-loop-value placeholder design and the exhausted-placeholder tests); relaxing the relpath rejection generally (weakens validation); chasing refs in _resolve_structured_output_artifacts for any raw value (broader than needed, would affect non-loop sources). Not covered: resume of a run interrupted after exhaustion, imported/nested loops beyond the single-loop program, targets 2.30/2.31 individually (2.29 and 2.32 tested), and the full test suite (not run per instructions). I did not verify the bugs/ README command output beyond the dry run compiling silently. Nothing committed.
value.summary: Loop results with path fields in non-exhausted union variants now compile and run at 2.29-2.32 as at 2.28, via two small fixes (validator ordering and loop-output ref chasing) plus regression tests.

value.account: Hubo dos causas, ambas solo a partir de 2.29. (1) Compilador, orchestrator/workflow_lisp/lowering/control_loops.py (_exhausted_inactive_placeholder_values): a 2.29+ se emitia un paso de placeholders y un override on_exhausted {ref} para cada campo no escalar de una variante inactiva, incluidos los relpath; el validador compartido rechaza cualquier override de salidas relpath ('may only override scalar'). Ahora los campos relpath se excluyen de esos placeholders, de modo que el frame del bucle conserva su placeholder propio, igual que a 2.28. (2) Runtime, orchestrator/workflow/loops.py (repeat_until_exhaustion_artifacts): una vez compilado, la agotacion fallaba incluso sin campos path (comprobado en el baseline) porque a 2.29+ el join lee result__* y el override {ref: root.steps.<loop>.artifacts.state__x} se quedaba sin dereferenciar ('not a valid integer'). Ahora, solo con version >= 2.29, se resuelve la ref compilada contra el frame de agotamiento o los artifacts del paso referido; a <=2.28 se persiste la ref cruda como antes (un test existente fija ese comportamiento). Alternativas descartadas: permitir en el validador la ref generada para salidas relpath (debilita la validacion y ademas no arregla el runtime, la ref seguia sin resolverse); dereferenciar sin gate de version (rompe test_loop_recur_on_exhausted_scalar_frame_carriage y cambia <=2.28). Tests: tests/test_workflow_lisp_loop_result_paths.py ejecuta el programa del bug con proveedores simulados a 2.28-2.32: agotamiento (UNRESOLVED, rounds 3), aprobacion (READY, report) y salida de proveedor malformada (../escape.md) que sigue fallando. Modulos relacionados ejecutados (loop_recur, scoped_union_guards, rich_loop_values_e2e, generic_state_exhaustion, loader_validation, executor_characterization, lowering, expressions, imported_stdlib_loop_exhaustion): pasan; 12 fallos en phase_stdlib/procedures son identicos antes y despues del cambio. No cubierto: campos path anidados en registros dentro de variantes inactivas con otros tipos no escalares (listas/mapas) mas alla de lo ya probado; no se ejecuto la suite completa; resume tras reanudacion en exhaustion a 2.29+ no probado explicitamente.
value.summary: Los campos relpath de variantes inactivas ya no generan overrides on_exhausted a 2.29+ y el runtime resuelve las refs de agotamiento a >=2.29, de modo que el programa compila y se comporta como a 2.28.

value.account:
Root causes (two, both only at targets >= 2.29):
1. Compile: orchestrator/workflow_lisp/lowering/control_loops.py `_exhausted_inactive_placeholder_values` emitted an `__exhausted_placeholders` step plus a `{ref}` on_exhausted override for every non-scalar inactive variant field, including relpath fields. Shared validation correctly rejects any on_exhausted override of a relpath output ('may only override scalar repeat_until outputs'). Relpath fields already get a loop-frame placeholder literal (loop-placeholder.txt, as at 2.28), so they are now excluded from the placeholder step; lowered output for the bug program matches 2.28 there.
2. Runtime (found only by actually running the program, compile alone looked fine): at 2.29+ the exhausted-variant fields are read from the loop's result__* artifacts, and on_exhausted `{ref}` overrides were persisted verbatim as dicts, so the match join failed with invalid_integer for result__rounds. At 2.28 the lowering bypasses this by sourcing the exhausted variant straight from state__*. orchestrator/workflow/loops.py `repeat_until_exhaustion_artifacts` now resolves `{ref}` overrides when workflow version >= 2.29 (own-frame refs from the exhaustion snapshot, others via executor._resolve_ref_value; unresolvable refs stay as written so the join still fails loudly). <2.29 keeps overrides verbatim.
Validation is untouched, so authored relpath overrides are still rejected; malformed provider paths still fail the run (tested).
Tests: tests/test_workflow_lisp_loop_result_paths.py runs the loop at 2.28..2.32 through the real executor with a patched provider: exhaustion -> UNRESOLVED rounds=2, approve -> READY with report path, malformed report path ('../escape.md') -> failed. 15 pass. Also the original bug program's --dry-run now succeeds at 2.32.
Considered and discarded: (a) moving the generated-ref check before the relpath check in validation.py: compiles, but weakens validation and the ref is then unresolved at runtime anyway; reverted. (b) re-enabling the 2.28 direct state__* case-ref at rich targets in `_loop_result_case_output_ref`: fixes this program but breaks test_lowering_target_229_preserves_done_payload_over_same_variant_exhaustion_state (a variant that is both done and exhausted must read the result), so reverted in favour of the runtime resolution.
Not covered: the targeted modules ran (loop_recur, rich_loop_values_e2e, scoped_union_guards, lowering, wcc_m4/m5, expressions, loader_validation, phase_stdlib, strict_boolean, verified_iteration_drain, imported stdlib exhaustion) with no new failures; 11 phase_stdlib and 6 key_migrations failures are pre-existing (identical before/after via stash). Full suite not run per instructions. Resume across an interrupted exhaustion at 2.29+ with ref overrides not specifically tested. Nothing committed.
value.summary: Relpath fields of inactive loop-result variants no longer get exhaustion placeholder refs (compile), and 2.29+ runtime now resolves on_exhausted ref overrides, so the program compiles and runs at 2.29-2.32 like 2.28.
